source_caption_text:
22 years ago today, Eminem released “Encore” and gave us songs that still take us right back to that era. 🥹💿

Released on November 12, 2004, the album featured “Mockingbird,” “Like Toy Soldiers,” “Just Lose It” and “Ass Like That.” From the personal storytelling to the outrageous music videos, the project captured several different sides of Eminem during one of the biggest periods of his career.

“Encore” debuted at No. 1 on the Billboard 200 after selling approximately 711,000 copies in just three days. Its release had been moved forward after songs leaked online.

More than two decades later, hearing the opening of “Mockingbird” or the chorus of “Like Toy Soldiers” can bring back a whole different time. Whatever your ranking of the album, those songs have stayed with listeners long beyond their original release.

What’s the first song you think of when you see this cover? 👀
